content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(MP-014 Browser Session-Token and Cookie Theft by Non-Browser Process) AND ABIOC(MP-014 Non-Interactive Entra Sign-In from Unusual Geo Post Token Theft) AND ABIOC(MP-014 AzureHound Bulk Microsoft Graph Enumeration Burst) within a 30-minute window, joined on the shared session identity (endpoint actor_effective_username maps to Entra user_principal_name maps to cloud_audit_logs identity_name, correlated by signin_activity_id and caller_ip). Fuses the endpoint token-theft signal, the anomalous non-interactive cloud sign-in, and the AzureHound Graph enumeration burst into a single escalation incident spanning the endpoint, cloud-identity, and cloud-audit planes instead of three low-fidelity alerts.
rules.name: AzureHound Cloud-Identity Enumeration Chain — Token Theft to Graph Discovery Stitch
